facts.fact: LANA reports the head of Libya's Commercial Registry Authority told a meeting of branch managers that the digital transformation plan is still being completed, including electronic linking of all regional branches and e-archiving of company files in every branch.

systems.owner: Commercial Registry Authority, Ministry of Economy and Trade

facts.fact: LANA reports the commercial registry's executive programme includes a phase of electronic linking with banks and relevant public bodies to exchange data and check companies' legal status instantly, presented as a stage still to be completed.
facts.system: Commercial registry electronic linking with banks and public bodies

LBY.note: Document concerns the registry authority's own digital transformation plan, a ministry-plan, not a national strategy.
